m1_real_defect.finding: At EXACTLY 1280px, three header labels broke mid-word as 'Assignment / s'. I had asserted 0 breaks at 1280 in three files.
why_my_detectors_missed_it: Detector 1: a canvas word-width check with a +0.5px float tolerance. The deficit is 0.2px (87px box vs 86.8px word), so the tolerance hid it.
Detector 2: a 'lines > words' heuristic. 'Total Open Assignment / s' renders 3 lines for 3 words, so a mid-word break can produce FEWER lines than words.
What worked: walking each character with a Range, recording its line box, and flagging two adjacent non-space characters on different lines.
m1_real_defect.confirmed_by_driver: Reproduced at 1280 (3 breaks) and clean at 1279 and 1281. 1280 is where xl activates with the least room it will ever have.
